about_the_game:
Duck and the Land of Flightless Birds is a charming platforming adventure. The controls are simple - simply jump, shoot, and flutter - but with layers of depth to master every setback is a lesson. Explore zany worlds, defeat cunning foes, and build your arsenal in this 2D action packed romp. Play as a fat duck that can't fly on your journey to get back stolen eggs.

Features

  • Tight platforming with a fluid movement system

  • Twitchy combat utilizing a unique leveling and weapon system

  • A world overflowing with personality

  • Iterative progression on your abilities throughout the game

  • Crisp visuals

  • A nice little story with an emphasis on humor

  • Secrets and Rewards for ADVANCED GAMERS

  • A sort of Controller Support (look I tried my very best I'm just one guy, please)

  • Banging Soundtrack™

  • One Cool Duck
